question: Swali
defaultDirections: Chagua jibu unalodhani linajibu swali. Ukimaliza, bonyeza {checkAnswer}. Utapata maoni yanayoonyesha kama jibu lako ni sahihi na jinsi ya kuendelea.

toggleEditingFeedbackBlocks: Washa/zima uhariri wa vizuizi vya maoni
